# Simba

> Leader election and distributed locks for the JVM. Each process opens one session on MySQL 8 / PostgreSQL 14+ (JDBC), Redis 7 or Zookeeper and contends for named leases; the winner gets a Term carrying a strictly increasing fencing token and a locally computed validity. Every onElected(term) is followed by exactly one onRevoked(term, reason), and leader work is interrupted and finished before the lease is released. A term is a weakly consistent view of the backend: resources that must reject a paused former owner have to check the fencing token.
